U-2-Net model
Authors: Xuebin Qin, Zichen Zhang, Chenyang Huang, Masood Dehghan,
Osmar R. Zaiane, Martin Jagersand.
Primary project: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
Model distribution: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0
U2NET ONNX SHA256: 8d10d2f3bb75ae3b6d527c77944fc5e7dcd94b29809d47a739a7a728a912b491
The model is unmodified. Source RGB is never generated by this model; it predicts
only the segmentation alpha used by the separately audited compositor.
